user.title: Set up HA-Wallpanel
user.description: Configure the global screensaver. Add ?kiosk to a Home Assistant URL to hide its sidebar and title bar.

data_description.views: Includes built-in and user-created dashboards as well as their individual Lovelace views.
data_description.cards: Adding a card opens Home Assistant's visual card browser and card editor.
data_description.colors: Select Add to open the color picker. Saved colors show a preview and hexadecimal value.
data_description.dashboard_brightness: 100% leaves the dashboard unchanged; 0% fades it completely to black.
data_description.screensaver_brightness: Applied to every screensaver panel independently of the dashboard.
data_description.brightness_schedule_enabled: Optional daily period with separate brightness levels; it may cross midnight.
data_description.schedule_enabled: The daily time range may cross midnight. Normal panel rotation resumes outside it.

error.invalid_cards: Add at least one valid Lovelace card with a type.
error.invalid_panels: Select at least one view, card, or fullscreen color.
error.invalid_transition: The transition time must not exceed the display time.
error.invalid_schedule: Check the schedule start, end, and playback mode.
error.invalid_brightness: Brightness must be between 0 and 100%, and the scheduled times must differ.
error.invalid_value: One or more values are invalid.

init.title: Configure HA-Wallpanel
init.description: Screensaver changes are sent immediately. Kiosk mode is enabled per device by adding ?kiosk to the URL.
